summary: Twelve power-user sessions walked in Graphite's window (Day look, Xvfb, S3's stand-in window manager, S4's stand-in udisks2/UPower/NetworkManager grown with a second drive, a network switch and a busy-unmount refusal, stand-in xrandr/wpctl) on a busy invented Home of X4's own (workbench/power_demo.py, built through its own door: 205 files in Downloads, 24 camera photos of 16 pictures, a budget as .ods and .csv, a bench table, a Writer report, two drives, and a workspace with Rail Demo beside 240 pages, 40 ideas and 30 findings/questions, 284 objects on the desk). Every session has frames (102: Day 1920x1200 for all twelve, 1366x768 for 4, 5 and 10) and a plain account with ranked lists for D2 and the coordinator (b100/X4.account.md). Session 7 drove a real LibreOffice Writer window through K9's stand-in AT-SPI bridge; session 9 ran under the real LS_XSESSION.sh supervisor with a stand-in START_OFFICE.sh; session 11's tuning sweep ran once on the 4B (410 s, its 240 s box) and the 4B was loaded, sealed and asked (a UTILITY draft, a question under HALT) once under the model lock. Two small fixes in place, marked 1.0 X4: the DELETE room's rows scroll (50 deletions were squeezed unreadable), and a refused eject names the program holding a file on the drive ('LibreOffice has a file on it open (process ...): close it there first, then eject again. Nothing was forced.'). Main findings: bulk file work has no route (single selection, no move line, Undo only the last of 48 moves); a fetch cut short when the network dropped counted 'done (verified)'; Search does not reach Home and opens hits in the legacy Cabinet record tab; a grant given while HALT holds did not carry its assignment through after RESUME; TRACE asks 'which did you mean?'; her column lags (after a restart it read 'No assignment is open'); window stalls up to 4.3 s (TRACE/CHECK ALL), 3.3 s (the tree waiting on the database), 1.8 s (HALT); the sandbox takes at most 8 files and Apply only adds files. Built, not tested; nothing ran on the ThinkPad.

decisions: X3 was not merged in this tree: the busy Home is X4's own module (workbench/power_demo.py), built through its own door; X3's account was read and its findings are not repeated except where a power user meets them harder.

Where no press exists for what a power user needs (assignment set-ups her plan would write, the model check run from its command, the Brain jobs), the walk called the Kernel itself and says so; stalls during those calls are counted apart from the window's own.
The seed was rebuilt in the throwaway copy before each run (as the merge does): without it any line refused 'Graphite seed/source binding is not current' after X4's source changes.

The busy-drive fix reads /proc for the owner's own processes only and names them by a small table of program names; the service's own words are kept beside it (service_said). Not seen on a real udisks2 here: the stand-in refuses a busy unmount as the kernel does.

native_sessions' owned Calc session was NOT switched to the gtk3 plugin: it starts a pinned engine through a Java helper, and whether that engine carries gtk3, and what it does to the owned window, cannot be seen here (this LibreOffice has only gen). Listed for the coordinator.
The bulk-files gap (multi-selection, batch move, one Undo) was ranked first for the coordinator instead of built: not a small fix (it touches L1's one selection and L6b's Undo).
The suspend in session 9 is a stand-in (the window's process frozen 4 s); logind's PrepareForSleep was not sent (no system bus here).
findings_for_the_coordinator: Bulk files have no route: single selection in the tree, no line step that moves or deletes, Undo only the last of a series (48 moves = 48 presses and 48 Undos).
K8: a fetch cut short when NetworkManager went down was counted "done (verified)" and NET still said "her fetch" after the drop.
Search does not reach Home's files, matches one phrase whole, lists a page twice, and its 'open' goes to the legacy Cabinet record tab; Back does not return to the results.

A grant given while HALT holds did not carry its assignment through after RESUME (its Resume ended with step 2 blocked); the built-in own-area grant does not cover a proposed assignment step writing in Files/Slate.
TRACE from her column on a finding focused on the board asks "Which of these did you mean?" instead of tracing it.

Her column lags (F2b): ACTIVE WORK and Waits for you stale for seconds after presses; after a supervisor restart 'No assignment is open' while the journal held one; 'no model yet' with the 4B active; 'her model is answering' after the model was stopped.

Window stalls (GRAPHITE_STALL_LOG): TRACE/CHECK ALL 4161 ms (1920) / 4322 ms (1366); the tree timer waiting on the database 3316 ms (1366), 1537 ms after a restart, 1840 ms first read (S11); board rebuild after a cell change 2118 ms; HALT 1776/1663/973 ms and RESUME 1493/1491/948 ms; asking her 1766 ms; opening a 205-file folder 855 ms; each Home move/delete/restore 340-490 ms; each line 300-364 ms.
Sandbox: at most 8 input files; Apply only adds new files/revisions (a dedupe-and-rename leaves the originals; no Undo for new files); the 4B on CPU gave no UTILITY draft within its 90 s budget.
A kept word has no slot for its source; a step after a word's total answers '0 rows' without saying why.
A stale seed makes lines and line steps refuse 'Graphite seed/source binding is not current' until it is rebuilt.
Her hand carries a passage of text, not a table: "a table from Calc into a Writer report" lands as one line; a Calc window from native_sessions stays closed to her hand (gen plugin).
With the stand-in window manager the dock lies over the window's head after a restart (no strut honoured): check on Fluxbox on the first evening.
Relevance on a 300-record desk lets look-alike pages (same words) stand as possible links at size 2 beside a revision.
Not walked: F2's 0.8.7 assignment left running in ACTIVE WORK (F2b takes it).
not_done: Frames only in the Day look (the coordinator's note asks Day for every session); the Graphite, Kasandra and Night looks were not framed for X4.
Session 7: the owner's Calc window was not opened visibly; Calc was read from the inside (K5) and her hand drove Writer only.

Session 9: the kill landed before step 2 was prepared, so 'prepared but not verified, inspected on resume' was not walked (K1's smoke covered it); the restart note on screen was not seen (the walk starts the window without qt_app.main).
Session 6: the 4B gave no draft in time, so the utility that ran was the owner's own text.
Session 11: whether HALT closed a running model turn was read from her words ('My model's answer was closed'), not from a turn record.
Session 8: whether the cut-short page's record says 'cut short' was not read.
D2, X3 and K10 (merged after this walk's start commit) were not in the walked tree: items they may fix are marked "may be fixed by D2" in the account.
release_note: X4: twelve power-user sessions walked on an invented busy Home (workbench/power_demo.py) with frames and an account; the DELETE room now scrolls with many deletions, and Eject safely on a busy drive names the program holding a file on it. Built, not tested.
